description: This file defines the SystemConfiguration class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to access and modify system configuration details such as organization info, admin details, language settings, and registration event handling. It interacts with a database via Doctrine DBAL and manages configuration through a helper class.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: Provides methods for reading and updating system configuration data in the OrangeHRM application, including organization info, admin details, language settings, instance identification, and registration event logging.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a Doctrine DBAL connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for database schema operations.

methods.name: getOrganizationName
methods.description: Fetches the name of the organization from the database.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Fetches the country of the organization from the database.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default language setting from configuration.

methods.name: getAdminFirstName
methods.description: Retrieves the first name of the admin user from the database.

methods.name: getAdminLastName
methods.description: Retrieves the last name of the admin user from the database.

methods.name: getAdminEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the admin user's email address.

methods.name: getAdminContactNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the admin user's contact number.

methods.name: getAdminUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the username of the admin user.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Gets the current instance identifier from configuration.

methods.name: getAdminEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Lazy loads and caches the admin employee number from database.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the instance identifier with new data based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded string as an instance identifier based on supplied data.

methods.name: isRegistrationEventQueueAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the registration event queue table exists in the database schema.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Inserts a registration event record into the event queue table.
